$comment: Cases both editors must judge alike. Each case is a source and the issues expected for it, sorted by start, end and code; offsets count UTF-16 code units. An issue without start and end is checked by code only: the two JavaScript parsers do not always place a syntax error on the same character. fixes holds the whole source after each quick fix, in the order offered. The severity and message, where a case gives them, are checked as well.

issues.message: Streamlord refuses "viewBox" at runtime: it has a capital, which the browser lowercases in an attribute name; write it as HTML has it, view-box or viewbox, or, for an attribute that has capitals such as SVG's viewBox, the object form dataAttr("{viewBox: ...}").

issues.message: Streamlord refuses "isOpen_" at runtime: it ends in _, which runs into the __ of the modifiers after it, so Datastar's client would read the key as is-open.

cases.name: a key holding __

issues.message: Streamlord refuses "fooBar__x" at runtime: it contains __, where Datastar starts reading modifiers.

cases.name: a null pair in dataSignals

issues.message: Datastar's client holds no null: in data-signals a null removes the key, so "selected" is not declared, and an expression that reads it gets "". Declare it with the value it starts as, such as "".

issues.message: patch is not defined in data-text: Datastar hands an expression patch only in data-on-signal-patch, so here it throws a ReferenceError.
